entries.Translated: 在窗口顶部选择一个字符。

entries.Original: Couldn't read the game's animation list.
entries.Translated: 无法读取游戏的动画列表。

entries.Original: How fast it plays (0 = paused on this frame).
entries.Translated: 播放速度（ 0 =在此帧上暂停）。

entries.Original: Play another race's version of the animation (experimental: the mod manager swaps the file for this character's collection). If the game already has the animation loaded, play another one first, then this one again.
entries.Translated: 玩另一个种族版本的动画（实验：改装配件管理器将文件换成此角色的集合）。如果游戏已经加载了动画，请先播放另一个动画，然后再播放这个动画。

entries.Original: Right-click an animation to add it to (or take it out of) your favourites.
entries.Translated: 右键单击动画以将其添加到（或从中删除）您的收藏夹。
双击播放。右键单击：收藏夹。

entries.Original: This character can't be read right now.
Takes off all gear: smallclothes, nothing on the head, no accessories (weapons kept).
entries.Translated: 脱下所有装备：小衣服，头上没有任何东西，没有配件（武器）。

entries.Original: The NPCs' smallclothes on body, hands, legs and feet; nothing on the head, no accessories.
entries.Translated: NPC身上、手上、腿上、脚上的小衣服；头上没有任何东西，也没有配饰。

entries.Original: The whole Emperor's New set (hat, robe, gloves, breeches, boots and accessories).
entries.Translated: 皇帝的全新套装（帽子、长袍、手套、马裤、靴子和配饰）。

entries.Original: Each change goes on as soon as you let go of it (race, clan, sex, face and colours redraw the character).
entries.Translated: 每次更改都会在您放手后立即进行（种族、氏族、性别、面孔和颜色重新绘制角色）。

entries.Original: The look it had when you first opened this page for it.
entries.Translated: 您第一次打开此页面时的外观。

entries.Original: This is a child's body: its appearance can't be changed here.
entries.Translated: 这是一个孩子的身体：它的外观在这里不能改变。

entries.Original: Each eye its own colour. Off: both eyes take the right eye's colour.
entries.Translated: 每只眼睛都有自己的颜色。关：两只眼睛都取右眼的颜色。

entries.Original: The game's colours couldn't be read: use the number.
entries.Translated: 无法读取游戏的颜色：使用数字。

entries.Original: The hairstyles couldn't be read: use the number.
entries.Translated: 无法读取发型：使用数字。

entries.Original: Facewear (glasses) by its number from the game (0 = none); press Enter.
entries.Translated: 面具（眼镜）按其在游戏中的编号（ 0 =无） ；按Enter键。

entries.Original:
Puts a look saved as a .chara file (the look files other posing tools save) on this character:
body, face, hair, colours, gear and weapons. Save it here afterwards to keep it with your looks.
entries.Translated:
将外观保存为.chara文件（其他姿势工具保存的外观文件）放在此字符上：
身体、脸部、头发、颜色、装备和武器。 之后保存在这里，以便与您的外观保持一致。

entries.Original: Hold Ctrl and click to delete this look.
entries.Translated: 按住Ctrl并单击可删除此外观。

entries.Original: An actor added with this look (Actors page) gets this name, and keeps this look. Empty: Limber 1, Limber 2...
entries.Translated: 使用此外观添加的Actor （ Actors页面）会获得此名称，并保持此外观。空： Limber 1 ， Limber 2...

entries.Original: A global preset (Global presets page) put on an actor added with this look.
entries.Translated: 全局预设（全局预设页面）放置在使用此外观添加的参与者上。

entries.Original:
Which mod collection this character is drawn with. Picking one gives this character its own;
"(the default)" takes that away again. It's redrawn either way.
entries.Translated:
此角色使用哪个改装配件集合绘制。 选择一个字符将赋予此字符自己的字符；
“（默认值）”再次将其删除。 无论哪种方式，它都会重新绘制。

entries.Original: Mod collection: the mod manager isn't available.
entries.Translated: 改装配件收藏：改装配件管理器不可用。

entries.Original: Reading the NPCs from the game's data...
entries.Translated: 正在从游戏数据中读取NPC...

entries.Original: Type at least two letters of a name.
entries.Translated: 键入至少两个名称字母。

entries.Original: more: type more of the name.
The NPC's whole look on the chosen character.
entries.Translated: NPC对所选角色的全部外观。

entries.RoleReason: 包含可翻译的独立显示位置；功能或未证明的位置保持原文，写入时逐位置核对

entries.Original: Keeps it under Looks (and for new actors on the Actors page).
entries.Translated: 将其保留在“外观”下（以及“演员”页面上的新演员）。

entries.Original: Body physics - how to use it###LimberBodyPhysicsHelp
Hover any slider or button on the Body physics page for a short explanation of it.
entries.Translated: 将鼠标悬停在人体物理页面上的任何滑块或按钮上，以获得简短的说明。

entries.RoleReason: 包含可翻译的独立显示位置；功能或未证明的位置保持原文，写入时逐位置核对

entries.Original: Turns the live body shape on or off (off whenever Limber starts). Shapes already built into your models stay.
entries.Translated: 打开或关闭活体形状（每当Limber启动时关闭）。您的模型中已内置的形状会保持不变。

entries.Original: Shows the sliders on the character straight away (only on your screen). Off: only what's built shows.
entries.Translated: 直接在角色上显示滑块（仅在屏幕上）。关闭：仅显示已构建的内容。

entries.Original: With Leg length: the body goes up by what the legs gained, so the feet stay where they were.
entries.Translated: 腿长：身体向上伸展双腿，双脚保持原状。

entries.Original: Only the sliders (or groups) whose name has this in it.
entries.Translated: 只有名称中包含此内容的滑块（或组）。

entries.RoleReason: 包含可翻译的独立显示位置；功能或未证明的位置保持原文，写入时逐位置核对

entries.Original:
Sculpted into the models when building (no live preview): press Build to see them, or turn on
Auto-build to build by itself a moment after you let go of one.
entries.Translated:
构建时雕刻到模型中（无实时预览） ：按构建查看它们，或打开
自动构建功能可在您放弃自动构建功能后自行构建。

entries.Original: Builds (and redraws the character) about a second after you let go of a detail slider.
entries.Translated: 在放开细节滑块大约一秒钟后构建（并重新绘制角色）。

entries.Original: Every slider back to the body as it is.
entries.Translated: 每个滑块都按原样返回身体。

entries.Original: Ctrl+click to type a value. Right-click: back to 0.
entries.Translated: Ctrl +单击键入值。右键单击：返回0。

entries.RoleReason: 包含可翻译的独立显示位置；功能或未证明的位置保持原文，写入时逐位置核对

entries.Original: Puts the preset's values on the sliders.
Saves the sliders as a preset with this name (replacing one with the same name).
entries.Translated: 将滑块保存为具有此名称的预设值（替换具有相同名称的预设值）。

entries.Original: Copies the sliders as text, to share or keep.
entries.Translated: 将滑块复制为文本，以共享或保留。

entries.Original: The clipboard doesn't hold a body shape.
" (Save to keep it as a preset).
Puts a copied body shape on the sliders.
entries.Translated: 在滑块上放置复制的体形。

entries.Original:
Bakes the shape into every model this character wears (body and outfit) as a mod above your
others in its collection, and redraws it. Your own mods are only read. Live-only sliders aren't built.
entries.Translated:
将形状烘焙到此角色穿着的每个模型中（身体和服装） ，作为您
在其集合中的其他人，并重新绘制它。 您自己的模组只会被读取。 不构建仅实时滑块。

entries.Original: Turns the built shape off for this character's collection (the sliders stay as they are).
entries.Translated: 关闭此角色集合的构建形状（滑块保持原样）。
内置于此角色的模型中。

entries.Original: The sliders differ from what's built: the difference shows live. Build again to bake it in.
entries.Translated: 滑块与构建的不同：差异实时显示。再次构建以将其烘焙。

entries.Original: Nothing built yet: the shape is live only.
entries.Translated: 尚未建造：形状仅为活体。

entries.Original: Breast shapes: no shaped top drawn yet.
entries.Translated: 乳房形状：尚未绘制形状顶部。

entries.Original: This character has no name to keep the settings under.
entries.Translated: 此角色没有名称可以保留设置。

entries.Original: Paused: the GPU soft body (Body physics) is on for this character, and both would change the same model. Turn the GPU soft body off to use the breast size shapes (the bone soft body works with them).
entries.Translated: 暂停：此角色的GPU软体（身体物理）已打开，两者都将更改相同的模型。关闭GPU软体以使用乳房大小的形状（骨骼软体与它们配合使用）。

entries.Original: This character isn't wearing a top with breast size shapes.
entries.Translated: 这个角色没有穿着胸围形状的上衣。
其顶部由以下材料制成：

entries.Original: If you turned the shaped top's mod on: another mod that changes the top (a Limber rigged model, a body mod) may have a higher priority in your mod manager. Give the shaped top the highest priority, or turn the other off.
entries.Translated: 如果您打开了形状顶部的模组：另一个改变顶部的模组（柔软的装配模型，身体模组）可能在模组管理器中具有更高的优先级。将形状的顶部置于最高优先级，或将其他形状的顶部关闭。

entries.Original: Off: the top is drawn as its model is, at its own size.
entries.Translated: 关闭：顶部按其模型绘制，以其自身尺寸绘制。

entries.Original: 0: a flat chest. About 12: small mounds. 30: small. 50: medium. 75: large. 100: huge.
Added to the size: below 0 smaller, and past 100 it carries on growing a little.
entries.Translated: 添加到尺寸：小于0 ，超过100则继续略微增长。

entries.Original: Take off the game's own bust scaling###bust_cancel
entries.Translated: 脱离游戏自身的半身像缩放

entries.Original: The game also scales the breast bones by the Bust slider; the shapes already are the size, so this takes that off.
entries.Translated: 游戏还通过胸部滑块缩放乳房骨骼；形状已经是大小了，所以这会脱落。

entries.Original: No camera to work with right now.
entries.Translated: 目前没有可供使用的摄像头。

entries.Original: Closer and further than the game allows, looking straight up or down, and a wider / narrower field of view.
entries.Translated: 比游戏允许的更近更远，向上或向下直视，视野更宽/更窄。

entries.Original: The camera passes through floors, walls and ceilings instead of bumping into them and pulling in.
entries.Translated: 摄像头穿过地板、墙壁和天花板，而不是撞到它们并拉进去。

entries.Original: Moves the camera (and what it looks at) sideways (+ right), up and forward, in metres, the way the camera looks.
entries.Translated: 将摄像机（及其所看到的内容）向上和向前移动（ +向右） ，以米为单位，与摄像机的外观相同。

entries.Original: How far the camera is from what it looks at (zoom). Ctrl+click to type.
entries.Translated: 摄像头距离其视线（缩放）的距离。Ctrl +单击键入。
更窄（长焦，更平坦）或更宽（更透视）。

entries.Original: The camera's angle round what it looks at.
entries.Translated: 摄像头的角度围绕着它所看到的内容。

entries.Original: The camera's tilt offset (what the game's camera height setting moves).
entries.Translated: 摄像机的倾斜偏移（游戏的摄像机高度设置移动的内容）。

entries.Original: Hold Ctrl and click to delete this shot.
entries.Translated: 按住Ctrl并单击可删除此镜头。

entries.RoleReason: 包含可翻译的独立显示位置；功能或未证明的位置保持原文，写入时逐位置核对

entries.Original: Plays like a Koikatsu character on this channel. Use one Koikatsu isn't using.
entries.Translated: 在这个频道上扮演Koikatsu角色。使用不使用的Koikatsu。

entries.RoleReason: 包含可翻译的独立显示位置；功能或未证明的位置保持原文，写入时逐位置核对

entries.Original: Enter GPose to pick other characters.

Two people: person 1 is whoever starts on the left of the video, person 2 on the right.
Tick this if they're the other way round.
entries.Translated:
两个人：人1是从视频的左边开始的人，右边的人2是从视频的右边开始的人。
如果它们是相反的，请勾选此项。

entries.Original: The penis as a chain of springs: Hardness decides how much the pose wins. 100%: exactly as posed / animated. Lower: it gives, hangs and swings with the body's moves. 0%: flaccid. Needs an IVCS / YAS skeleton with a penis (iv_ochinko bones). Kept for this character by name; only on your screen.
entries.Translated: 阴茎作为弹簧链：硬度决定姿势的胜率。100% ：与姿势/动画完全一致。较低：随着身体的动作，它会产生、悬挂和摆动。0% ：松弛。需要有阴茎的IVCS/YAS骨骼（ iv_ochinko骨骼）。按名称保留此角色；仅在屏幕上显示。

entries.RoleReason: 包含可翻译的独立显示位置；功能或未证明的位置保持原文，写入时逐位置核对

entries.Original: 100%: holds the pose exactly. 0%: flaccid (hangs, swings). Anything between: firm but gives a little, half hard...
entries.Translated: 100% ：完全保持姿势。0% ：松弛（悬挂、摆动）。任何介于两者之间的东西：公司，但给了一点，半硬...

entries.Original: How long it keeps swinging after a move (0%: settles at once).
entries.Translated: 移动后持续摆动的时间（ 0% ：一次结算）。

entries.Original: How much it hangs down when it isn't hard.
entries.Translated: 当它不难的时候，它挂了多少。

entries.Original: How much the body's speeding up and turning swings it (0%: moves with the body).
entries.Translated: 身体加速和转动的速度（ 0 ％ ：随身体移动）。

entries.Original: How much it resists bending at each joint: higher keeps its shape and swings as one piece from the base (no warping when it's heavy or soft); lower lets it curl and fold.
entries.Translated: 它在每个关节处抵抗弯曲的程度：越高，其形状和摆动就越好（重或柔软时不会翘曲） ；越低，其卷曲和折叠就越好。

entries.Original: While this character is Oral's partner, the shaft stays as posed (the mouth follows it).
entries.Translated: 当这个角色是Oral的搭档时，杆身保持姿势（嘴巴跟着它）。

entries.Original: Give every bone along the penis its own hardness, bounce, weight and inertia (base to tip), instead of the settings above for all of them. E.g. a firm base with a softer, heavier tip.
entries.Translated: 为阴茎沿线的每块骨骼赋予其自身的硬度、弹性、重量和惯性（从底部到尖端） ，而不是上述所有设置。例如，带有较软、较重的尖端的坚固底座。

entries.Original: Copy the settings above to all###dyn_copyall
entries.Translated: 将上述设置复制到所有
坚固的底座，柔软的尖端

entries.Original: 100%: this bone holds the pose exactly. 0%: it hangs and swings.
entries.Translated: 100% ：这块骨头完全保持姿势。0% ：悬挂和摆动。

entries.Original: How long this bone keeps swinging.
entries.Translated: 这块骨头持续摆动的时间。

entries.Original: How heavy this bone is: how much it hangs down when it isn't hard.
entries.Translated: 这块骨头有多重：当它不硬时，它会垂下多少。

entries.Original: How much this bone trails behind when the body moves.
entries.Translated: 当身体移动时，这块骨头会落后多少。

entries.Original: How much this joint resists bending against the bone before it.
entries.Translated: 这个关节在它之前抵抗骨头弯曲的程度。

entries.Original: The chosen character goes limp and falls where they stand.
entries.Translated: 所选角色一瘸一拐地摔倒在原地。

entries.Original: They get back up (back to their pose).
entries.Translated: 他们重新站起来（回到自己的姿势）。

entries.Original: Shoves them again while they're down (a random way, up and over).
entries.Translated: 在他们倒下时再次推他们（随机，上下）。

entries.Original: Choose a character at the top first.
entries.Translated: 首先从顶部选择一个字符。

entries.Original: How much a part bounces back off the floor.
entries.Translated: 零件从地板上反弹了多少。

entries.Original: How far they slide along the floor (high: like ice).
entries.Translated: 它们在地板上滑动多远（高：像冰一样）。

entries.Original: This character has no name to keep the face pose under.
entries.Translated: 此角色没有保持脸部摆姿势的名字。

entries.Original: Changing a left or right bone changes the one on the other side the mirrored way.
entries.Translated: 更改左侧或右侧骨骼会以镜像方式更改另一侧的骨骼。

entries.Original:
Dots on the character's face bones: click one to pick it, drag it to move it.
Tip: Freeze motion first, so the animation's own expression doesn't fight you.
entries.Translated:
人物脸部骨骼上的点：单击一个以选择它，拖动它以移动它。
提示：首先冻结动作，这样动画本身的表情就不会与您对抗。

entries.Original: Takes every face bone's offset off (Undo at the top brings it back).
entries.Translated: 消除每个面部骨骼的偏移量（顶部的撤消将其带回）。

entries.Original: This character's face isn't available right now (GPose, and Limber on?).
entries.Translated: 此角色的脸部目前不可用（ GPose和Limber开启？ ）。

entries.Original: Drag: move across / up.  Alt + drag: forward / back.
entries.Translated: 拖动：横向/上移。Alt +拖动：向前/向后。

entries.Original: Pick a bone on the face map, in the list, or on the face in the scene.
entries.Translated: 在面部地图上、列表中或场景中的面部上挑选骨骼。

entries.Original: Across (+ = the character's left), up, forward (out of the face).
entries.Translated: 跨越（ + =角色的左侧） ，向上，向前（从脸上）。

entries.Original: About the face's axes: tip (nod), turn (shake), tilt.
entries.Translated: 关于面部的轴：尖端（点头）、转动（抖动）、倾斜。

entries.Original: Click to add it to your favourites.
entries.Translated: 点击将其添加到您的收藏夹。

entries.Original: A favourite: click to take it out.
This character has no name to keep the pose under.
entries.Translated: 此角色没有要保持姿势的名字。
entries.RoleReason: 包含可翻译的独立显示位置；功能或未证明的位置保持原文，写入时逐位置核对

entries.Original: Each bone's FK is a turn added to what the animation does, so the character keeps animating (breathing, emotes, idles) with your pose on it. Freeze motion (top of the window) to hold everything still.
entries.Translated: 每个骨骼的FK是添加到动画的回合，因此角色保持动画（呼吸，表情，闲置）与您的姿势。冻结运动（窗口顶部）以保持静止。

entries.Original: Each bone you pose holds its own turn and stops animating; the bones you haven't touched keep animating.
entries.Translated: 您摆出的每个骨骼都会保持其自身的回合并停止动画；您尚未触摸的骨骼会继续动画。
控制页眉主体中左侧，中央和右侧部分的顶部和底部内边距。
从屏幕上显示的内容开始

entries.RoleReason: 包含可翻译的独立显示位置；功能或未证明的位置保持原文，写入时逐位置核对

entries.Original: Copies the pose on screen (animation, IK and all) into FK, bone by bone, so it holds still and you can edit it.
entries.Translated: 将屏幕上的姿势（动画、IK和所有）复制到FK ，逐个骨骼，以便保持静止，您可以对其进行编辑。

entries.Original: Swaps left and right: each side takes the other's pose, reflected.
entries.Translated: 左右互换：每边采取对方的姿势，反射。

entries.Original: Every bone to the skeleton's own rest pose (the pose the model is built in).
entries.Translated: 骨骼自身休息姿势的每个骨骼（模型内置的姿势）。

entries.Original: Removes every FK turn on this character (undo brings it back).
entries.Translated: 删除此角色的每次FK开启（撤消将其带回）。

entries.Original: This character's bones aren't available right now (GPose, and Limber on?).
entries.Translated: 此角色的骨骼目前不可用（ GPose和Limber开启？ ）。

entries.Original: This character's bones aren't available right now.
entries.Translated: 此角色的骨骼目前不可用。
entries.RoleReason: 包含可翻译的独立显示位置；功能或未证明的位置保持原文，写入时逐位置核对

entries.Translated: 搜索骨骼（手臂、手指、尾巴... ）

entries.Original: Pick a bone in the list, or click its dot in the scene.
entries.Translated: 在列表中选择一个骨骼，或单击场景中的点。

entries.Original: IK has a goal on this bone (IK Posing page): IK decides where it ends up.
entries.Translated: IK在这块骨头上有一个目标（ IK姿势页面） ： IK决定它最终会在哪里结束。

entries.Original: Pinned: it stays where it is while the rest of the body moves.
entries.Translated: 固定：当身体其他部分移动时，它会保持在原位。

entries.Original: Hold this bone where it is now: the body can move and turn, and the limb bends to keep it there.
entries.Translated: 将这块骨头固定在现在的位置：身体可以移动和转动，四肢弯曲以保持在那里。

entries.Original: Stop holding it in place (it keeps any other IK goal it has).
entries.Translated: 停止将其固定到位（它保留了其拥有的任何其他IK目标）。

entries.Original: Removes the pin (or any IK goal) from this bone: FK and the animation move it again.
entries.Translated: 删除此骨骼的针脚（或任何IK目标） ： FK ，动画再次移动它。

entries.Original: The gizmo and the quick turns go round the bone's own axes.
entries.Translated: 辅助图标和快速转弯绕过骨骼自身的轴。

entries.Original: The gizmo and the quick turns go round the world's axes (X across, Y up, Z forward in the scene), whatever way the bone faces.
entries.Translated: 无论骨骼面向何方，控件和快速转弯都会绕着世界的轴（场景中的X向上， Y向上， Z向前）。

entries.Original: Not posed with FK yet: it follows the animation. Turning it starts from where it is now.
entries.Translated: 尚未与FK一起摆姿势：它遵循动画。转动它从现在的地方开始。

entries.Original: Turn added to the animation (0 / 0 / 0 = as it animates):
entries.Translated: 添加到动画的转弯（ 0/0/0 =动画） ：

entries.Original: On: 0 / 0 / 0 is the skeleton's rest pose for this bone. Off: the bone's whole turn relative to its parent.
entries.Translated: 开： 0/0/0是骨骼对此骨骼的休息姿势。关闭：骨骼相对于其父级的整个旋转。

entries.Original: X / Y / Z (degrees, the bone's own axes). Drag, or double-click to type.
entries.Translated: X/Y/Z （度，骨骼自身的轴）。拖动或双击键入。

entries.Original: Holds the bone at a place relative to its parent too (stretches the joint). The gizmo's move mode sets it.
entries.Translated: 将骨骼保持在相对于其父级的位置（拉伸关节）。辅助图标的移动模式设置它。

entries.Original:
On: the bones under this one go with it when you turn or move it (usual FK).
Off: they stay where they are; only this bone turns / moves (bones under it that you posed with FK still follow it).
entries.Translated:
开：当您转动或移动它时，它下面的骨骼会与它一起移动（通常是FK ）。
关闭：它们停留在原地；只有这块骨头转动/移动（您与FK合影的骨头仍然跟随它）。

entries.Original: This bone to the skeleton's rest pose.
entries.Translated: 这个骨头对着骨骼的休息姿势。

entries.Original: Removes FK from this bone: it follows the animation again.
entries.Translated: 从此骨骼中删除FK ：它再次跟随动画。

entries.Original: The bone on the other side takes this bone's pose, reflected (and so do the bones below it that FK holds).
entries.Translated: 另一侧的骨骼采取这种骨骼的姿势，反射（ FK保持的骨骼也是如此）。

entries.Original: This bone and every bone below it follow the animation again.
entries.Translated: 此骨骼及其下方的每个骨骼再次跟随动画。

entries.Original: In the scene: click a dot to pick its bone; the rings turn it (Posing settings: the gizmo can also move, and use world or the bone's axes). Purple dots are bones FK holds.
entries.Translated: 在场景中：单击点以选择其骨骼；环转动它（姿势设置：辅助图标也可以移动，并使用世界或骨骼的轴）。紫色圆点是FK持有的骨头。

entries.Original: Choose a character at the top: everything Limber has for them is saved as one preset.
entries.Translated: 在顶部选择一个角色： Limber为他们提供的所有内容都将保存为一个预设。

entries.Original: Every page's settings in this preset replace the chosen character's.
entries.Translated: 此预设中的每个页面设置都会替换所选角色的设置。

entries.Original: Edit this preset: set the chosen character up the way you want, then press this to save it over the preset.
entries.Translated: 编辑此预设值：按照您想要的方式设置所选字符，然后按此键将其保存在预设值上。

entries.Original: Hold Ctrl and click to delete this preset.
entries.Translated: 按住Ctrl并单击以删除此预设。

entries.Original: When a player or actor with this name comes into the scene (or is added), they get the preset and look.
entries.Translated: 当具有此名称的玩家或演员进入场景（或添加）时，他们将获得预设和外观。

entries.Original: Adds a rule for this name (empty: the character chosen at the top).
entries.Translated: 为此名称添加规则（空：顶部选择的字符）。

entries.RoleReason: 包含可翻译的独立显示位置；功能或未证明的位置保持原文，写入时逐位置核对

entries.Original: Hold Ctrl and click to delete this rule.
entries.Translated: 按住Ctrl并单击可删除此规则。

entries.RoleReason: 包含可翻译的独立显示位置；功能或未证明的位置保持原文，写入时逐位置核对

entries.Original: Click the star next to an item to add it to your favourites.
entries.Translated: 单击餐点旁边的星标，将其添加到您的收藏夹。

entries.Original: more: search to narrow it down.
Pick an item to see it here.
entries.Translated: 选择一个项目以在此处查看。

entries.Original: Starts (or stops) penis and testicle throbbing together, their beats starting at the same moment.
entries.Translated: 开始（或停止）阴茎和睾丸一起跳动，它们的节拍在同一时刻开始。

entries.Original: Start the growth over from its own size.
entries.Translated: 从自身的规模重新开始增长。
